name: web_auto_form
description: Automates real-browser interactions for form filling, submission, and data extraction. Supports sequential atomic operations with conditional branching, structured extraction, PII redaction, and self-healing selectors. Trigger when the user requests web form automation, auto-registration, data entry, sign-up, or any multi-step browser interaction task.

url.description: The starting URL to navigate to before executing steps. Must be a valid HTTPS or HTTP URL (HTTP triggers a security warning).

data.description: Data object for parameterized execution. Use {{key}} template variables in string fields (value, file_name, description, selector, selector_fallbacks, condition.expected_value, and every field of a locator). Supports dot notation for nested keys, e.g. {{user.name}}. SECURITY: template data must not change a locator's structure. Prefer a locator with strategy 'role', 'label', 'text', 'placeholder' or 'testid', where the value is passed to Playwright as an argument. With 'id'/'name'/'attr' the value is escaped into a quoted CSS attribute value. A raw css/xpath value may not contain a placeholder at all; a css selector may contain one only in an attribute-value slot (e.g. [name='{{x}}'], input[name='{{x}}']). Anything else fails with TEMPLATE_ERROR before the browser starts. The same rule forbids placeholders in `wait` type=function `value` (JavaScript in page context) and in `if` expected_value when operator is matches_regex.

consent_statement.description: Required declaration of automation purpose. Logged before execution. In non-headless mode, displayed and confirmed before proceeding.

steps.description: Ordered list of atomic browser operations to execute sequentially.

selector.description: Legacy string locator. CSS, XPath (prefix with //), #id, [name='value'], [placeholder='text'] or [data-testid='value']; the type is auto-detected from the prefix when selector_type is omitted. Required for fill/select/check/click/upload/extract/assert actions UNLESS `locator` is given — the two are mutually exclusive. Supports {{template}} variables only in an attribute-value slot with a literal prefix, e.g. [name='{{field}}'] or input[name='{{field}}']; anywhere else they fail with TEMPLATE_ERROR. Prefer `locator` for new config.

selector_type.description: Type of selector provided. Auto-detected if omitted.

selector_fallbacks.description: Backup selectors tried in order when the primary does not match. The first match wins. A structurally invalid candidate (bad syntax) aborts the chain with INVALID_SELECTOR instead of falling through, because a malformed locator means the config is wrong. Only when every candidate matches nothing does the optional logic apply. Supports {{template}} variables under the same rules as `selector`.

locator.description: Structured locator. Preferred over `selector`: the strategy states how to find the element instead of relying on a parsed string, and semantic strategies are the safe way to parameterise a locator with template data. Mutually exclusive with `selector`.

value.description: The argument for the strategy. Supports {{template}} variables for every strategy except css/xpath.

role.description: ARIA role name, for strategy 'role'. Supports {{template}} variables.

name.description: Accessible-name filter, for strategy 'role'. Supports {{template}} variables.

prefix.description: Literal CSS prefix emitted before the attribute test, e.g. 'input' in input[name=...]. Preserved verbatim, so a trailing space stays a descendant combinator.

exact.description: Exact match instead of Playwright's default substring + whitespace-normalized matching. Applies to role/label/text/placeholder; id/name/attr/testid are always exact attribute matches.

locator_fallbacks.description: Backup locators tried in order when the primary does not match. Structured equivalent of selector_fallbacks, with the same resolution and abort-on-structural-error rules. Requires `locator`.

value.description: Value payload. Supports {{template}} vars from the data object. For fill: text to type. For select: option text or value. For check: 'true'/'false'. For navigate: URL. For press_key: key name (Enter, Tab, Escape). For handle_dialog: 'accept'/'dismiss'. For scroll: 'up'/'down'/pixel count. For upload: local path, https:// URL, data: URI, or file: URL. For wait type=timeout: milliseconds as string (e.g. '3000'). For wait type=function: JavaScript expression. Ignored for click/extract/assert.

file_name.description: Override the file name presented to the upload endpoint. Useful when value is a URL or data: URI. Supports {{template}} vars. When value is a remote URL, this also renames the downloaded temp file; extension mismatch with MIME type triggers a warning but does not block upload.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in ms for the element to appear. 0 = no wait.

type.description: Wait subtype. 'element' = wait for selector to appear. 'navigation' = wait for page URL change or load event. 'timeout' = unconditional sleep (value must be milliseconds as string). 'function' = poll until JS expression in value returns truthy.

state.description: For assert action: the expected state of the element matched by selector. For if condition: the state to check (mutually exclusive with operator/expected_value).

operator.description: For if condition: comparison operator against expected_value. Mutually exclusive with state — if both are provided, operator takes precedence.

expected_value.description: For if condition: the expected value to compare against, using operator. Compared against the attribute specified in condition.attribute (default: textContent).

on_fail.description: Failure policy applied to every action, not just assert. 'abort' (default) = record the failure and stop the workflow; later steps do not run. 'continue' = record the failure and keep going (the run ends 'partial'). 'retry' = re-run this step up to max_retries additional times, then abort. An abort raised inside a nested 'if' branch propagates out and stops the whole workflow.

max_retries.description: Step-level retry override. Counts ADDITIONAL attempts on top of the first: max_retries=2 means at most 3 executions. When set, overrides options.max_retries for this step only.

retry_on.description: Step-level retry-on override. The error code must be listed here AND be intrinsically retryable for an automatic retry to happen. Intrinsically retryable: TIMEOUT, NETWORK_ERROR, NAVIGATION_FAILED, ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE, ELEMENT_NOT_INTERACTABLE. Never retryable: ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_SELECTOR, ASSERTION_FAILED, FILE_UPLOAD_FAILED, TEMPLATE_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR, UNKNOWN. When set, overrides options.retry_on for this step only.

optional.description: If true, a failure is recorded as 'skipped' instead of failing the workflow, and execution continues. This takes precedence over on_fail. The fallback chain is always exhausted before optional logic triggers.

on_skip.description: Refines an optional step's failure. 'log' = record a warning and continue. 'abort' = halt execution. 'set_default' = continue using the value field as fallback content.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot after this individual step. Useful for debugging.

description.description: Human-readable label for this step. Supports {{template}} variables.

condition.description: For 'if' action: condition to evaluate. Use state-based checks (exist/visible/checked etc.) OR value-based comparisons (operator + expected_value), not both.

selector.description: Selector for the element to evaluate. Supports {{template}} variables under the same attribute-value-slot rule as a step selector, and never inside an XPath.

attribute.description: Attribute to read for comparison. Use 'checked' for checkboxes, 'value' for inputs, 'textContent' for visible text, or any HTML attribute name.

state.description: State-based check. Mutually exclusive with operator/expected_value.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Mutually exclusive with state.

expected_value.description: Expected value for comparison. Supports {{template}} variables, EXCEPT when operator is matches_regex — there the value becomes the regex pattern and a template would be a ReDoS primitive, so it is rejected with TEMPLATE_ERROR.

then.description: For 'if' action: steps to execute when condition evaluates to true.

else.description: For 'if' action: steps to execute when condition evaluates to false.

extract_schema.description: Structured extraction schema applied after all steps complete.

name.description: Field name in the output result.

selector.description: CSS/XPath selector for the element. Supports {{template}} variables under the same attribute-value-slot rule as a step selector, and never inside an XPath.

attribute.description: What to extract: 'text', 'innerHTML', 'value', or any HTML attribute name.

redact.description: Per-field PII redaction override. When set, overrides options.redact_pii for this field only. Use false for non-PII fields like application_id to preserve raw values even when global redaction is on.

screenshot.description: Capture a full-page screenshot after all steps.

step_delay_ms.description: Mandatory delay inserted between each step to stabilize DOM state and avoid triggering anti-bot detection.

max_retries.description: Default additional attempts per step on top of the first (max_retries=1 means up to 2 executions). Can be overridden per-step via step.max_retries.

retry_on.description: Error codes eligible for automatic retry. A code must be listed here AND be intrinsically retryable. Can be overridden per-step via step.retry_on or per-step via on_fail=retry.

sandbox.description: Force browser sandbox mode to prevent malicious page escape.

redact_pii.description: Global PII redaction switch. Applies to BOTH log output (value fields printed as <redacted>) AND extracted text (phone/email/ID replaced with ***). Can be overridden per-field via extract_schema.fields[].redact.

debug.description: When true: save page HTML and screenshot after each step, output full Playwright logs, keep browser open after completion.

debug_output_path.description: Directory for debug artifacts (HTML snapshots, screenshots, Playwright logs). Created automatically if it does not exist.

keep_open.description: Do not close browser after completion. Useful for manual inspection in debug mode.

upload_enforce_extension.description: When true, block upload if file_name extension does not match the detected MIME type. When false (default), warn but allow.

diagnose_on_failure.description: When true (default), automatically capture a screenshot and visible form elements on the FINAL failed attempt of a step (not on every retry). Included inline in the results JSON so AI Agents can self-repair selector strategies without re-running.
